description.en: Restores the gameplay camera from a saved "exit" camera slot, used when leaving a cutscene/sub-scene back into normal RPG gameplay.
Index of the exit-camera slot to restore from.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Restore the gameplay camera after a cutscene ends
CMND_COPY_EXIT_CAMERA(1);
